title: Costs of administration.
bodyText: In administering a trust, the trustee may incur only costs that are reasonable in relation to the trust property, the purposes of the trust, and the skills of the trustee.
bodyHtml: [§554D-805]  Costs of administration.  In administering a trust, the trustee may incur only costs that are reasonable in relation to the trust property, the purposes of the trust, and the skills of the trustee. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
